2607.27287.title: PIE-APT: A Unified Framework for Temporal Planning and Contradiction Hunting via Incremental Direct-Derivation Abduction
2607.27287.paper_summary: Reasoning and planning over Dynamic Knowledge Graphs (DKGs) present significant challenges, especially in open-world environments with incomplete information. Existing action formalisms often face decidability issues and the Ramification Problem, while managing incomplete knowledge via structural abduction requires expansive combinatorial search. This paper introduces a unified framework with two integrated modules---\textbf{PIE-Abducer} (incremental direct-derivation abduction) and \textbf{PIE-APT} (Abductive Planning for Temporal KGs)---operating natively on the highly expressive Description Logic. We model state transitions along a linear timeline as non-monotonic updates to deductively closed DL theories. Treating the incremental reasoner as a black-box and representing actions natively in OWL without external modal operators preserves logical decidability. To address incomplete knowledge, \textbf{PIE-Abducer} circumvents traditional Minimal Hitting Set (MHS) enumeration. Instead of combinatorial syntactic search, it injects the logical negation of a target goal into a consistent branch and extracts missing premises via direct refutation consequences. \textbf{PIE-APT} then employs a recursive \textit{Generate-and-Test} architecture, interleaving backward-chaining A* search with \textbf{PIE-Abducer} up to a bounded causal depth, followed by strict validation via forward-chaining Temporal Projection. We evaluate four OWL benchmarks stressing semantic abilities absent in classical planning: parameterized goals with witness search, mid-search DL entailment, open-world assumption injection, and adversarial contradiction hunting. Results demonstrate qualitative superiority over classical planners and prove our direct-derivation approach quantitatively outperforms an MHS-faithful baseline during abductive enrichment.
2607.27287.paper_summary_zh: 推理和規劃在動態知識圖 (DKGs) 上面臨重大挑戰，特別是在資訊不完整的開放世界環境中。現有的行動形式主義經常面臨可決定性問題和推理後果問題，而通過結構性推斷管理不完整知識則需要廣泛的組合搜索。本文介紹了一個統一框架，包含兩個集成模組——\textbf{PIE-Abducer}（增量直接推導推斷）和\textbf{PIE-APT}（時間知識圖的推斷規劃）——這些模組在高度表達性的描述邏輯上原生運行。我們將沿著線性時間線的狀態轉換建模為對演繹閉合的 DL 理論的非單調更新。將增量推理器視為黑箱，並在 OWL 中原生表示行動而不使用外部模態運算符，保持了邏輯的可決定性。為了應對不完整知識，\textbf{PIE-Abducer} 繞過傳統的最小擊中集 (MHS) 列舉。它不進行組合語法搜索，而是將目標目標的邏輯否定注入到一致的分支中，並通過直接反駁後果提取缺失的前提。接著，\textbf{PIE-APT} 採用遞迴的 \textit{生成與測試} 架構，將向後鏈接的 A* 搜索與 \textbf{PIE-Abducer} 交錯進行，直到有限的因果深度，然後通過前向鏈接的時間投影進行嚴格驗證。我們評估了四個 OWL 基準，強調了在傳統規劃中缺失的語義能力：帶有見證搜索的參數化目標、中途搜索的 DL 蕴涵、開放世界假設注入和對抗性矛盾狩獵。結果顯示出相對於傳統規劃者的質量優越性，並證明我們的直接推導方法在推斷增強過程中定量上超越了忠實於 MHS 的基準。
2607.27287.author: Amir Hossein Sharafi et.al.
